reason: I pick the cheapest option every time and I don't do subscriptions, so a monthly fee at a price nobody has even set yet, on top of moving money to some broker partner I've never heard of, is a no. My broker app already does monthly auto-investing and is rolling out its own AI help for free.
objection: Why would I pay a monthly fee for something my free broker already mostly does? A cute pet doesn't make my returns any better, and every dollar of fee comes straight out of my returns.
would_change_my_mind: If the real-money plan were free or a flat fee of a couple of dollars a month, with no extra trading or fund costs, and it clearly did something my current broker doesn't.
